name: Vintage Sketch
tagline: bang-motion's sketsa vintage: sepia paper, Playfair display, rust and gold inks, engravings, tracked caps labels.

motion.direction: bang-motion sketsa vintage. Sepia paper with a multiply texture; Playfair Display 700–900 titles (≈104 px) in sentence case, tracked small caps labels (0.16 em) in rust `ter`, gold `gold` rules and ornaments (`back.out(2)` 0.5 s), ink `#2E2115` and a second ink `goldd`; `imageCard`s as engravings (grayscale, multiply) in oval or square plates; a wax-seal `stamp`; `counter`s in old-style figures. Everything fades and settles slowly, the camera pushes 1–2 %; nothing bounces. Clean serif captions.
